fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. 1. Admission priority will be given to applicants who can provide letters of recommendation. 2. Admission priority will be given to applicants holding New HSK Level 4 Certificates * 3. Personal statement Please write your introduction according to the personal statement template (undergraduate) in the teaching language of the professional program (for example, the statementfor a program taught in Chinese should be written in Chinese, and the statement for aprogram taught in English should be written in English). You can download a template or sample from here . 4. Admission priority will be given to applicants who can provide other supporting materials e.g. award certificates, foreign entrance examination transcripts, university admission notice, etc. * 5. A Chinese Name You can create a Chinese name for yourself, write it in document and upload here since it is necessary for applying to Tongji University. If you didn't upload or fill in application form, then we will have to create a Chinese name for you. You may communicate with teacher to change it later though. * 6. Physical Health Report (in the last six months). * 7. Personal information page of the passport(Passport valid until March 1, 2027 and beyond) * 8. A Self-introduction Video -Please speak in English or Chinese. -The video should be at least 2 minutes long, in MP4 format, and less than 7 MB. -Include a brief self-introduction, your study plan after enrollment, reasons for applying to this program and university in China, and your plans after graduation. -You may also highlight your language ability, interests, confidence, and motivation. * 9. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. * 10. Original or notarized transcripts of all courses in high school For a transcript in a language other than Chinese and English, the original notarized copy of the Chinese or English translation must be provided. The notarized copy must be issued by a Chinese embassy or consulate abroad, or a foreign embassy and consulate in China; We recommend that you attach a description of the evaluation criteria of the transcripts. The results of the national senior high school entrance examination or the internationally accepted test results of the country of origin, such as UEC/A Level/AP/IB/SAT/ACT, can also be submitted as supplementary materials. * 11. High school diploma For a certificate in a language other than Chinese and English, the original notarized copy of the Chinese or English translation must be provided. The notarized copy must be issued by a Chinese embassy or consulate abroad, or a foreign embassy or consulate in China; The original graduation certificate issued by the school of a new high school graduate needs to be provided. Upon admission, you need to bring the original high school graduation certificate for verification during registration; For a Malaysian SPM diploma, the certificate of completion of one-year preparatory studies and transcript of the preparatory courses are also required. * 12. Copy of English proficiency certificate IELTS 6.5 / TOEFL IBT 85 or above. The original certificate is required to be submitted at the registration, if the student is admitted.(Applicants who are native English-speakers or have studied in English-medium high schools are not required to submit English proficiency certificates.) * 13. CSCA Test Transcript(s) -You need to take the official CSCA test organized by the Chinese government and submit the corresponding subject result transcript(s) when applying. Learn more about the CSCA test >> -The test covers Chinese (Humanities and STEM Chinese), Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry. Mathematics is required for all programs, while other subjects depend on the university’s specific requirements. -We are updating detailed information for each university, including the required subjects you have to take for each program and their score requirements. Once the updates are ready, you can check the attachment and information here for this university for the latest information. If no attachment is available yet, it usually means the university has not announced further details. - For MBBS program: the required subjects are Mathematics and Chemistry — the test papers need to be in English. Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
fields.requirements: Entry Requirements 1. Self-supporting students: applicants aged between 18 and 35(up to and includingDecember 31 in the year of application)Non-Chinese citizens who have graduated from high school or aboveand are in good health; 2. Applicants who are immigrants from the Chinese mainland, Hong Kong, Macao,and Taiwan (China) and are a foreign national, or whose parents are both Chinese citizens and have settled abroad,or whohavebeen a foreign nationalsince birthmust meet the requirements of the Ministry of Education's Jiao Wai Han [2020] No.12; 3. Applicants under the age of 18 (before August 31 in the current year). 4. Proof of language proficiency: IELTS test certificate with total score no less than 6.5 or TOFEL IBT certificate with total score no less than 85 or GRE certificate with total score no less than 310. International students from English speaking countries or graduated from international high schools teaching in English do not need to provide English language certificate when submitting the admission application.The Original certification version should be provided when making registration. International students from English speaking countries or graduated from international high schools teaching in English do not need to provide English language certificate when submitting the admission application. If the English proficiency test certificate cannot be provided on time due to the epidemic, please submit a personal statement on your English proficiency first. The college will notify the alternative assessment methods and contents in accordance with specific conditions. 5. For students applying for the Civil Engineering program, the CSCA exam subjects are Mathematics and Physics(the test papers are in English).
